verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack never documents an API explorer or runnable-example reference for AWS. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path. The CLI's auto-prompt, which can surface documentation, is an adjacent command-line feature, not an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
